raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 is a re-delivery: at 05:00 on 2026-01-19 it re-sent some transactions with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1768716186000 = 2026-01-18 06:03:06 UTC, matching the original row), which breaks the TIMESTAMP cast. It also duplicates txn_ids (5244 rows vs 4866 distinct), which would double-count gold totals even if the cast succeeded. The fix is to parse epoch-ms timestamps and keep one row per txn_id, earliest-delivered first.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '[0-9]+') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, ingest_ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) ORDER BY ingest_ts) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
